answer: The clinic book lists every animal by name, owner, complaint, and treatment, in the order they came through the door. Proof of veterinary surgeon registration via royal college of veterinary surgeons is a book of that kind: a registration the royal college has renewed after every clinical assessment. One invented patient needs a pen. Two hundred need two hundred animals, two hundred owners who never walked in, and the ferrous of each is the empty kennel at the back — the sonnet is the nurse who took the temperature, the dune the book, its pages smelling of disinfectant.
